text:
=== sync-hermes-context.sh ===
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# sync-hermes-context.sh — mirror /opt/data/workspace/hermes-context/ (or $HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC)
# into /workspace/hermes-context/ (or $HERMES_CONTEXT_DST).
# One-way host->workspace sync (A2). rsync primary, tar fallback (A4), both converge to
# an exact recursive mirror with stale deletion at all depths (A5/A7).
# Stage -> content-verify -> touch DST, for BOTH paths (A13). Dry-run is zero-write (A6/A16).
# Refusals cite the violated law (A19).
set -u

PROG=$(basename "$0")

refuse() { echo "refused: $1: $2" >&2; exit 1; }
log()    { printf '%s %s\n' "$(date +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z)" "$*" >> "$LOGFILE" 2>/dev/null || true; }

# --- 1a. parameters (A17: env override is the contract mechanism) -----------------
DRY_RUN=0
VERIFY_ONLY=0
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --dry-run)  DRY_RUN=1 ;;
    --verify)   VERIFY_ONLY=1 ;;
    *) echo "unknown argument: $arg" >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

SRC="${HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC:-/opt/data/workspace/hermes-context/}"
DST="${HERMES_CONTEXT_DST:-/workspace/hermes-context/}"

# canonicalize once (strip trailing slashes); all later mutation goes through these
while [ "$SRC" != "${SRC%/}" ]; do SRC="${SRC%/}"; done
while [ "$DST" != "${DST%/}" ]; do DST="${DST%/}"; done

# --- 1b. guards: BEFORE any write; component-split / realpath based ---------------

# A18: degenerate paths (component tests, not slash-suffix strings)
for p in "$SRC" "$DST"; do
  [ -n "$p" ]          || refuse "A18" "degenerate path (empty) rejected"
  [ "$p" != "." ]      || refuse "A18" "degenerate path '.' rejected"
  [ "$p" != "/" ]      || refuse "A18" "degenerate path '/' rejected"
done

# boundary-aware containment (component split, never string-prefix) (A15)
contains() { # contains ANCESTOR PATH -> true if PATH == ANCESTOR or inside it
  [ "$2" = "$1" ] && return 0
  case "$2" in "$1"/*) return 0 ;; esac
  return 1
}

# A12: realpath identity / ancestor / descendant / DST-resolves-into-SRC
RSRC=$(realpath "$SRC" 2>/dev/null) || refuse "A12" "source path does not resolve: $SRC"
RDST=$(realpath -m "$DST" 2>/dev/null) || refuse "A12" "destination path does not resolve: $DST"
[ "$RSRC" != "$RDST" ] || refuse "A12" "realpath(SRC) == realpath(DST): $RSRC"
contains "$RSRC" "$RDST" && refuse "A12" "DST ($RDST) is inside or resolves into SRC ($RSRC)"
contains "$RDST" "$RSRC" && refuse "A12" "SRC ($RSRC) is inside DST ($RDST)"

# A14/A15: owned concrete instantiated paths — log dir parent, stage path, entrypoint dir
# stage path computed by PURE string computation, no mktemp/mkdir/write yet (A20)
LOGDIR="$HOME/.cache/hermes-context"
LOGFILE="$LOGDIR/sync.log"
STAGE_PARENT="$LOGDIR"
STAGE="$STAGE_PARENT/.hc-stage.$$"

# entrypoint dir (concrete resolved dir of this script) must not touch the mirror
SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" 2>/dev/null && pwd) || SCRIPT_DIR=""
if [ -n "$SCRIPT_DIR" ]; then
  contains "$RDST" "$SCRIPT_DIR" && refuse "A14" "entrypoint dir ($SCRIPT_DIR) is inside DST — sync would delete its own entrypoint (A8)"
  contains "$SCRIPT_DIR" "$RDST" && refuse "A14" "entrypoint dir ($SCRIPT_DIR) contains DST"
  contains "$RSRC" "$SCRIPT_DIR" && refuse "A14" "entrypoint dir ($SCRIPT_DIR) is inside SRC"
fi

# log dir / stage parent (concrete instantiated path) must not touch SRC or DST boundaries
for owned in "$LOGDIR" "$STAGE_PARENT"; do
  contains "$RDST" "$owned" && refuse "A14" "owned path ($owned) is inside DST (A8: log/stage never inside mirrored tree)"
  contains "$owned" "$RDST" && refuse "A14" "owned path ($owned) contains DST"
  contains "$RSRC" "$owned" && refuse "A14" "owned path ($owned) is inside SRC"
  contains "$owned" "$RSRC" && refuse "A14" "owned path ($owned) contains SRC"
done

# --- 1c. dry-run: plan to stdout ONLY, zero side effects (A6/A16) -----------------
if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "dry-run plan (no writes performed):"
  echo "  source:      $SRC -> $RSRC"
  echo "  destination: $DST -> $RDST"
  echo "  strategy:    $(command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'rsync -a --delete (primary)' || echo 'tar-pipe fallback + recursive reconcile')"
  echo "  actions:     stage contents of SRC, content-verify, then replace DST wholesale (stale entries deleted at any depth)"
  echo "  log:         $LOGFILE (not written in dry-run)"
  exit 0
fi

# --- --verify: compare existing DST against SRC, MIRROR class, nonzero on mismatch
if [ "$VERIFY_ONLY" -eq 1 ]; then
  verify_copy() { # $1=src $2=dst ; recursive content/type/symlink-target comparison
    local s=$1 d=$2 rel
    [ -d "$d" ] || return 1
    while IFS= read -r rel; do
      [ -n "$rel" ] || continue
      if [ -L "$s/$rel" ]; then
        [ -L "$d/$rel" ] || return 1
        [ "$(readlink "$s/$rel")" = "$(readlink "$d/$rel")" ] || return 1
      elif [ -d "$s/$rel" ]; then
        { [ -d "$d/$rel" ] && [ ! -L "$d/$rel" ]; } || return 1
      elif [ -f "$s/$rel" ]; then
        { [ -f "$d/$rel" ] && [ ! -L "$d/$rel" ]; } || return 1
        cmp -s "$s/$rel" "$d/$rel" || return 1
      fi
    done < <(cd "$s" && find . -mindepth 1 | sed 's|^\./||' | LC_ALL=C sort)
    while IFS= read -r rel; do
      [ -n "$rel" ] || continue
      if [ ! -e "$s/$rel" ] && [ ! -L "$s/$rel" ]; then return 1; fi
    done < <(cd "$d" && find . -mindepth 1 | sed 's|^\./||')
    return 0
  }
  if [ ! -d "$RDST" ]; then
    echo "verify failed: destination does not exist: $DST" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if verify_copy "$RSRC" "$RDST"; then
    echo "verify OK: DST matches SRC (contents, recursive dirs, symlinks)"
    exit 0
  else
    echo "verify failed: DST does not match SRC (A9)" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi

# --- 1d. real run: now (and only now) create owned paths and DST -------------------
STAGE_CREATED=""
cleanup() { [ -n "$STAGE_CREATED" ] && rm -rf "$STAGE"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

mkdir -p "$LOGDIR" || { echo "cannot create log dir $LOGDIR" >&2; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$STAGE_PARENT" || { echo "cannot create stage parent $STAGE_PARENT" >&2; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$STAGE" || { echo "cannot create stage $STAGE" >&2; exit 1; }
STAGE_CREATED=1

log "run start src=$RSRC dst=$RDST"

# --- 1e. build MIRROR-class staged copy --------------------------------------------
if command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # primary: contents of SRC into stage, delete anything extra, symlinks preserved as links
  rsync -a --delete --copy-links=no "$SRC/" "$STAGE/" \
    || { log "FAIL rsync staging"; echo "rsync staging failed" >&2; exit 1; }
else
  # A4/A7 fallback: tar-pipe, then recursive reconcile deleting stale entries at all depths
  tar -C "$SRC" -cf - . | tar -C "$STAGE" -xf - \
    || { log "FAIL tar staging"; echo "tar fallback staging failed" >&2; exit 1; }

=== README.md ===
# sync-hermes-context

One-way sync of the hermes context tree from the host mount into the workspace.
Source of truth is the host mount; the workspace copy is a mirror — stale entries
are deleted at any depth on every run.

## Paths (contract, env-overridable)

- Source: `HERMES_CONTEXT_SRC` (default `/opt/data/workspace/hermes-context/`)
- Destination: `HERMES_CONTEXT_DST` (default `/workspace/hermes-context/`)

Env override is the mandated parameterization mechanism; deployed defaults are
production values. Sync is strictly one-way (host -> workspace); nothing is ever
written back to the source.

## Install

1. Copy the script outside the mirrored tree:

   ```
   install -m 0755 sync-hermes-context.sh ~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh
   ```

2. Copy the user units:

   ```
   mkdir -p ~/.config/systemd/user
   cp hermes-context.service hermes-context.timer ~/.config/systemd/user/
   systemctl --user daemon-reload
   systemctl --user enable --now hermes-context.timer
   ```

The service runs `%h/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh` as a oneshot unit; the
timer fires every 6 hours (`OnCalendar=*-*-* 00/6:00:00`, `Persistent=true`).
Check status with `systemctl --user status hermes-context.timer` and
`journalctl --user -u hermes-context.service`.

The script also runs standalone (cron, manual) with no systemd dependency.

## Dry-run test

```
~/.local/bin/sync-hermes-context.sh --dry-run
```

`--dry-run` emits a plan to stdout only: no files or directories are created
anywhere, no log is written, and if the destination does not exist it stays
absent. Verify the destination is byte-identical (or still nonexistent) after a
dry-run before doing a real run.

There is also `--verify`: compares an existing destination against the source
(contents, recursive directories, symlink targets) and exits nonzero on any
mismatch, including when the destination does not exist.

## Sync strategy

- Primary: `rsync -a --delete --copy-links=no SRC/ stage/` — contents of the
  source (no nesting) staged first.
- Fallback (no rsync available): `tar -C SRC -cf - . | tar -C stage -xf -`
  followed by a recursive reconcile that deletes stale entries at all depths.

Both paths converge identically to an exact recursive mirror: same contents,
same recursive directory structure, symlinks preserved as symlinks. The staged
copy is content-verified against the source (files, directories, symlink
targets) before the destination is touched; if verification fails the run exits
nonzero and the destination is left untouched. Only after a content-compared
staged copy exists is the destination replaced wholesale, which is what removes
stale files and directories at any depth on both sync paths.

## Refusals (guards)

The script refuses — cleanly, with a cited law and nonzero exit, before any
write — when:

- A18: source or destination is degenerate (`/`, empty, `.`)
- A12: `realpath(SRC) == realpath(DST)`, either path is an ancestor/descendant
  of the other, or the destination (through symlinked ancestors) resolves into
  the source — checks are realpath-based, not lexical prefix checks
- A14/A15: the script-owned log dir, staging path, or the script's own
  entrypoint directory would collide with (be inside, contain, or equal) the
  source or destination boundaries

Staging lives under `~/.cache/hermes-context/` (never inside SRC, DST, or
TMPDIR-root), the log is `~/.cache/hermes-context/sync.log` (always outside the
mirrored tree), and the installed entrypoint is outside the mirrored tree, so a
sync can never delete its own entrypoints or logs. Source survival outranks
freshness: the destination is only replaced after a verified copy of the source
exists elsewhere.

## Logs

Real runs append to `~/.cache/hermes-context/sync.log`. Dry-runs write nothing,
including no log.

## KNOWN_LIMITATIONS

- Exotic filenames (newlines/control characters): not guaranteed lossless under
  self-verification (A21).
- Adversarial environment-variable combinations beyond the A14 owned-path guard
  (e.g. hostile `TMPDIR`/`HOME` redirections aimed at the destination) are out
  of scope (A14).

Verify function:

verify_copy() { # src dst -> 0 ok
  local s=$1 d=$2 rc=0
  [ -d "$d" ] || return 1
  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    [ -z "$rel" ] && continue
    local sp="$s/$rel" dp="$d/$rel"
    if [ -L "$sp" ]; then
      [ -L "$dp" ] || { rc=1; break; }
      [ "$(readlink "$sp")" = "$(readlink "$dp")" ] || { rc=1; break; }
    elif [ -d "$sp" ]; then
      [ -d "$dp" ] && [ ! -L "$dp" ] || { rc=1; break; }
    elif [ -f "$sp" ]; then
      [ -f "$dp" ] && [ ! -L "$dp" ] || { rc=1; break; }
      cmp -s "$sp" "$dp" || { rc=1; break; }
    fi
  done < <(cd "$s" && find . -mindepth 1 ! -name '.prunelist*' | sed 's|^\./||' | LC_ALL=C sort)
  [ $rc -eq 0 ] || return 1
  # reverse: extra in dst
  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    [ -z "$rel" ] && continue
    [ -e "$s/$rel" ] || [ -L "$s/$rel" ] || return 1
  done < <(cd "$d" && find . -mindepth 1 | sed 's|^\./||')
  return 0
}
